QuestInfo.name: Making Red Jade
QuestInfo.0: Apparently a special gem called the #bRed Jade#k can help you regain some power. But how do you make Red Jade? Maha ought to know.
QuestInfo.1: Maha told you that if you use the Mirror of Desire, you can learn how to get a #t4032312#. Well, better go to #b#m140030000##k.
QuestInfo.2: You made the Red Jade through the Mirror of Desire, and it seems that #p1201002# is satisfied with the result. With help from #p1201002#'s skill with jewels, a little bit of the power you once had has returned.
